question: Does requiring all four old mechanisms to have finite predictions hide informative price-only versus price-and-DIF differences?
scope: Same saved120 and90 inputs, original locked candidate, two unchanged reference policies and three unchanged gates. No new inputs or parameter fitting.
price_basis: Same maximum close in positive wave ending at structure confirmation; on negative confirmation use immediately preceding positive wave.
window: After top structure, before first new top DULL, strict DIF break of original reference, next top STRUCTURE, or input end. Exclude the competing bar. Censoring is a diagnostic design, not software expiry.
negative_phase: Require a strictly negative histogram on or after confirmation and before or on the price-only prediction; no bottom symmetry.
selection: Keep price-only finite with price-and-DIF later OR not observed before censoring; report all six variants, gate instability, competitors and censored status. Rank stable120 then stable90. No missing-hit equals rule false forever.
prefix_check: Replay only through each prediction and each last observed bar; verify candidate row and first-hit history. Later censoring metadata is retrospective and not a real-time feature.
sources: Do not fetch new material before saving screen. Known source coverage is context, not held-out evidence. Do not request known unavailable images.
invalidation: A new unambiguous dated structure-withdrawal observation must fall between differing predictions; prediction equality adds no discrimination. Software historical values remain necessary near numerical boundaries.
